summary: This Dockerfile sets up a development container based on Microsoft's Python 3.11 image and configures the working directory where code will live. It's a minimal setup that provides a ready-to-use Python environment for development.

explanations.2: This pulls a pre-built image from Microsoft's container registry that already has Python 3.11 installed along with development tools, so we don't have to set up Python from scratch.
explanations.8: This sets /workspaces/blog_analyzer as the default location inside the container where commands will run and files will be organized, similar to changing directories before working on a project.
